meta.fit: every decisive UFC fight 2010-01-01..2025-12-31 (tools/ml2.py train_mask, the page model's rows), both corner orientations; frozen configuration out/ml2_cache/cv.json; 2026 dropped at parse
meta.prediction: per seed p = 0.5 (f(g0) + 1 - f(g1)); seeds averaged in logit space; blend logit = w_lr logit(p_lr) + w_lgb logit(p_lgb) + w_xgb logit(p_xgb) (clip 1e-6), no intercept

builder.note: a_/b_ side levels (age: a missing DOB takes the opponent's age, else 30); d_ = the logistic design values (A minus B; ml2.js termValues) plus the ml.py base terms the logistic dropped (extra_terms, from ml.json's roster: roster_extra); m_ = ml.py matchup_features with the live division priors (antisymmetric terms flip sign with the corners, symmetric ones do not); context lbs / women / title / five / catch; extras nprior, market-rating variance at the fight (min(sd^2 + tau^2 years since the last rated fight, 2 v0)), round-WHR sd, pre-UFC presence, min prior fights, both rated
